deferrals.name: mcp
deferrals.reason: openhands-sdk 1.59.0 requires fastmcp>=3.2.0,<4, which requires mcp<2.0. Defer MCP 2.x until a supported SDK/fastmcp release removes that constraint.

deferrals.name: OSS_CAD_SUITE_RELEASE
deferrals.reason: OSS CAD Suite is deferred: its ghdl-yosys plugin (share/yosys/plugins/ghdl.so) fails to load under the bundled yosys (2026-10-29: undefined symbol _ZN5Yosys7autoidxE; verified in a ubuntu:26.04 container). Stay on 2026-10-12 until a nightly ships a working ghdl plugin.

Latest stable is 3.15, but the sdk-check group's openhands-sdk->litellm->fastuuid chain pins fastuuid 0.14.0 (sdist only, no cp315 wheel) and its bundled PyO3 fails to build on 3.15. pydantic-core has shipped cp315 wheels as of 2.50.1, so fastuuid is the sole blocker - re-check when fastuuid publishes a 3.15-capable release.
